title: Connect Slite Agent to any MCP server
summary: Slite connects to the tools where work happens to build and maintain the knowledge your business depends on, so your team and their AI can work from reliable answers.
body_markdown:
Slite Agent can now answer from Granola, Miro, Monday.com and Box, and from any tool with an MCP server added as a custom source. An admin adds a source once, then each member connects their own account, and answers only use what that member can access. Box needs a one-time setup by a Box admin, who registers Slite as an app in Box.


[Connect a source →](https://slite.slite.page/p/rq0NP470QfqQ3E/Custom-MCP?utm_source=changelog&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=slite-sources)


### Slite Agent reads images


Paste or upload images in Slite Agent and ask about them. The agent reads the image together with your documentation.


[Ask about an image →](https://slite.slite.page/p/L9d4yUkzcZAiNZ/Ask-the-Agent-about-images-and-screenshots?utm_source=changelog&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=slite-agent#5qzFFaopBXAn1C)


### Tables and images at the width you want


Full width used to mean the whole screen, which on a big monitor stretches a table into a long strip. Tables, images and sketches now resize to any width in between, so a wide table gets room without taking over the page. Hover a table and click the *Fluid width* icon at its top left to try it.


### Improvements


- **Verification notices above the title.** Outdated and verification requests now show in a card at the top of the document, and it collapses as you scroll.
- **Faster app and notes.** Slite starts and opens notes faster, and editing large tables and collections is quicker, with undo that now goes past 100 steps.
- **Slite Agent finds the source you name.** Ask it to "check Granola" and it searches that source instead of skipping it. MCP sources also show their own icon and the name you gave them.
- **Renames in change requests.** A proposed new title shows as a diff, with the old title struck through.
- **Intercom images in the Slite Agent extension.** Images from an Intercom conversation are attached automatically and stay attached for follow-up questions.
- **Links to deleted documents.** They now show a "Document not found" tooltip instead of leading nowhere.
- **Global context limit.** The agent's global context shows a live counter for its 10,000-character limit.


### Fixes


- The editor is more stable, including when you reconnect after losing your connection.
- Tables and collections no longer break on empty cells, and pasting dates and numbers into collection fields reads them correctly.
- Exported documents import back as the same blocks, and AI and MCP edits now target exactly what should change instead of rewriting parts of the document.
- Slite Agent citations show as citation chips again.
- Linear connections refresh on their own instead of expiring silently.
- Videos play again in help center articles and exports.
